description:
Framework-agnostic core: annotations (@WorkflowInterface, @ActivityInterface,
    ...), the deterministic replay engine, WorkflowClient, and Worker. Depends
    on nothing but protobuf/gRPC, Jackson (default DataConverter), and SLF4J
    (logging facade only — no bound implementation). No Spring, no Quarkus,
    no Micronaut, no application framework of any kind: every other module in
    this project depends on this one, never the other way around.
